outcome: foetal admission in Intensive Care Unit (ICU)
cohort: 27 COVID-19 positive obstetric patients (age 19-37 years; mean gestational age 34.84+/-7.75 weeks) admitted to JSS medical college, Mysuru, Karnataka, India, between October 2020 and December 2020.
finding: In COVID-19 positive pregnant patients, if managed properly without complications, outcomes are generally good for mother and baby, with low risk of vertical transmission.
mod_finding: Of the 20 deliveries, 12 were by LSCS, 6 were vaginal, 1 was emergency laparotomy, and 1 was incomplete abortion.
followup_time: Variable, with some participants lost to follow-up after diagnosis and others having repeat COVID-19 testing
